package handler

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/entitysync/policy"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/clock"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/spatial"
	"math"
	"slices"
	"time"

	db "example.com/slg-alliance-practice/db"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/activity"
)

type IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.PlayerDao
}

var errAllianceReward = errors.New("alliance reward: invalid identity, home, amount or full ledger")

// 仅由受信任的原服建档入口调用。Player 始终归属首次持久写入的 sid，不迁移。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceHomeInit(p IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity, sid int32) (int64, error) {
	if sid != 1000 && sid != 1001 {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	if old := p.Dao().GetHomeSID(); old != 0 {
		if old != sid {
			return 0, errAllianceReward
		}
		return p.Dao().GetGold(), nil
	}
	p.Dao().SetVisionMask(13) // 501、503 长期授权，504 限时侦察；502 未授权。
	// 首次建档赠送一次侦察；重试在上方返回，绝不重算期限。时间来自服务器业务钟。
	p.Dao().SetScoutUntil(clock.Now().Add(time.Hour).UnixMilli())
	p.Dao().SetX(800)
	p.Dao().SetY(800)
	p.Dao().SetCoverage("[]")
	p.Dao().SetHomeSID(sid)
	p.Dao().SetReceipts("{}")
	return p.Dao().GetGold(), nil
}

// 金币和永久回执同一 Player strict 事务。key 与 amount 来自原服持久义务，
// sid 来自本进程可信配置；本方法不是公网 handler，不允许客户端自报奖励。
// 同身份重试必须金额一致；账本满后拒新身份，不淘汰旧身份。RPC / Redis 读取在事务外。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceCredit(p IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity, sid int32, key activity.Key, amount int64) (int64, error) {
	if p.Dao().GetHomeSID() != sid || (sid != 1000 && sid != 1001) || key.Validate() != nil || key.Phase != activity.PhaseSettle || amount <= 0 || amount > 100000 {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	receipts := map[string]int64{}
	if e := json.Unmarshal([]byte(p.Dao().GetReceipts()), &receipts); e != nil || receipts == nil {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	if old, ok := receipts[key.String()]; ok {
		if old != amount {
			return 0, errAllianceReward
		}
		return p.Dao().GetGold(), nil
	}
	if len(receipts) >= 128 || p.Dao().GetGold() > math.MaxInt64-amount {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	receipts[key.String()] = amount
	raw, e := json.Marshal(receipts)
	if e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	p.Dao().SetGold(p.Dao().GetGold() + amount)
	p.Dao().SetReceipts(string(raw))
	return p.Dao().GetGold(), nil
}

// 仅内部恢复核对使用，不能把永久账本同步给客户端。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceWallet(p IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity) (string, error) {
	raw, e := json.Marshal(struct {
		ScoutUntil int64
		VisionMask int64
		X, Y       int64
		Coverage   string
		Home       int32
		Gold       int64
		Receipts   string
	}{p.Dao().GetScoutUntil(), p.Dao().GetVisionMask(), p.Dao().GetX(), p.Dao().GetY(), p.Dao().GetCoverage(), p.Dao().GetHomeSID(), p.Dao().GetGold(), p.Dao().GetReceipts()})
	return string(raw), e
}

// 内部教学移动入口；坐标和覆盖由服务器规则产生，不接客户端自报覆盖。
// 同一 strict 事务保存位置和覆盖，空间索引只接已提交事实；reject 是回滚验收注入点。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceMove(p IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity, interest *policy.Interest, syncer *entitysync.Manager, x, y int64, blocks []int64, reject bool) (int64, error) {
	before := syncer.Subscribers(p.ID())
	component, e := policy.NewSpatialComponent(p, interest, func(at spatial.Point) { p.Dao().SetX(at.X); p.Dao().SetY(at.Y) })
	if e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	if e = component.MoveWithObservedBlocks(spatial.Point{X: x, Y: y}, blocks); e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	raw, e := json.Marshal(blocks)
	if e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	p.Dao().SetCoverage(string(raw))
	// 特意在事务尚未提交时驱动一次政策/发布，验证索引不能抢先放出对象。
	if e = syncer.Flush(context.Background()); e != nil {
		return 0, e
	}
	if !slices.Equal(before, syncer.Subscribers(p.ID())) {
		return 0, errors.New("uncommitted spatial subscription escaped")
	}
	if reject {
		return 0, errors.New("injected movement rollback")
	}
	return x, nil
}

// 受信任原服撤销某个目标的侦察权；与位置同属 Player 持久事实，客户端不能自报授权。
// reject 只用于验收 undo，实际接入由服务器权限规则调用。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceRevokeVision(p IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity, sid int32, target int64, reject bool) (int64, error) {
	if p.Dao().GetHomeSID() != sid || target < 501 || target > 504 {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	next := p.Dao().GetVisionMask() &^ (int64(1) << uint(target-501))
	p.Dao().SetVisionMask(next)
	if reject {
		return 0, errors.New("injected vision rollback")
	}
	return next, nil
}

// ScoutMap 属于本原服的教学地图权威，不把公共敌军位置塞入 Player。
// 跨 sid 地图必须另接 Remote/Saga，不能把这里的 MultiSync 当作分布式快照。
type IAllianceMapEntity interface {
	entity.IThreadSafeEntity
	Dao() *db.ScoutMapDao
}
type scoutMove struct {
	Target, X, Y       int64
	Expected, Revision uint64
}
type scoutMapState struct {
	Revision uint64
	Targets  map[int64]spatial.Point
	Moves    map[string]scoutMove
}

func readScoutMap(m IAllianceMapEntity) (scoutMapState, error) {
	var state scoutMapState
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(m.Dao().GetState()), &state)
	if err != nil || state.Revision == 0 || len(state.Targets) != 4 || state.Moves == nil {
		return state, errAllianceReward
	}
	return state, nil
}
func saveScoutMap(m IAllianceMapEntity, state scoutMapState) error {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err == nil {
		m.Dao().SetState(string(raw))
	}
	return err
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceMapInit(m IAllianceMapEntity) error {
	if m.Dao().GetState() != "" {
		_, err := readScoutMap(m)
		return err
	}
	return saveScoutMap(m, scoutMapState{Revision: 1, Targets: map[int64]spatial.Point{
		501: {X: 700, Y: 700}, 502: {X: 710, Y: 700}, 503: {X: 800, Y: 800}, 504: {X: 720, Y: 700},
	}, Moves: map[string]scoutMove{}})
}

// 坐标来自可信地图模拟。固定命令身份与原参数同持久写入，未知结果只重试原身份；
// 不同命令按预期地图版本写，账本满拒新身份，不淘汰旧回执。reject 仅供回滚验收。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceTargetMove(m IAllianceMapEntity, key string, expected uint64, target, x, y int64, reject bool) (uint64, error) {
	state, err := readScoutMap(m)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if key == "" || len(key) > 64 || target < 501 || target > 504 || x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= 1000 || y >= 1000 {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	if old, ok := state.Moves[key]; ok {
		if old.Target != target || old.X != x || old.Y != y || old.Expected != expected {
			return 0, errAllianceReward
		}
		return old.Revision, nil
	}
	if expected != state.Revision || state.Revision == math.MaxUint64 || len(state.Moves) >= 128 {
		return 0, errAllianceReward
	}
	state.Revision++
	state.Targets[target] = spatial.Point{X: x, Y: y}
	state.Moves[key] = scoutMove{target, x, y, expected, state.Revision}
	if err = saveScoutMap(m, state); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if reject {
		return 0, errors.New("injected target movement rollback")
	}
	return state.Revision, nil
}

//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceMapSnapshot(m IAllianceMapEntity) (string, error) { return m.Dao().GetState(), nil }

// 同一 Nest 锁住本服 Player 与地图，读取权限和位置的联合已提交快照。
// 返回仅供内部筛选，账本与期限不向客户端发送。
//
//roost:nest rollback=undo durability=strict
func handlerAllianceVision(p IAllianceRewardPlayerEntity, m IAllianceMapEntity) (string, error) {
	state, err := readScoutMap(m)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		X, Y, VisionMask, ScoutUntil int64
		Revision                     uint64
		Targets                      map[int64]spatial.Point
	}{p.Dao().GetX(), p.Dao().GetY(), p.Dao().GetVisionMask(), p.Dao().GetScoutUntil(), state.Revision, state.Targets})
	return string(raw), err
}
